messages:
deploy-bot: Pre-release safety checks completed for release v2.4.3. Prompt suite regression detected: 1 failing subset (conversational-summary). Blocking flag: true. Details: <https://ci.redwood.internal/evals/8921>. Run `./scripts/run-prompt-suite --subset=conversational-summary` to reproduce.

maria.w: Seen. Can you paste a quick sample of the failure output?

deploy-bot: Sample excerpt:
```
input: "User: summarize my meeting notes"
baseline: "Concise summary with next steps."
candidate: "Partial and missing next steps."
metric_drop: -0.062
```

kevin: Ugh. That looks like the tokenizer change we landed in the serving lib. I expected maybe formatting diffs, not a semantic drop. Leaning to pin model back for today's rollout.

zack: I agree with pin unless we can patch within the change window. Change window ends in ~45m. How long to rollback if we decide?

jen: If we pin we should also update the release notes and notify stakeholders. Product needs to sign off on holding.

kevin: @product-ops can you weigh in? Also I'll run a focused eval on that subset (quick) to confirm magnitude.

product-ops: Looking. Pinged PMs. If this is >3% on a user-facing summarization metric we should hold. If it's a formatting-only regression, we might proceed with a note.

kevin: K running quick job: `ci/run_eval --suite conversational-summary --model candidate --n=200` ETA ~4m

deploy-bot: Job eval-8921 started. Logs: <https://ci.redwood.internal/logs/eval-8921>. ETA ~4m.

maria.w: If the quick eval shows >3% drop across the subset, my vote is pin to v2.4.2 and re-run full regression overnight.

sre-oncall: Ops can route canary traffic back to stable in ~2m if we need to hold. We can flip routing without infra changes.

kevin: Quick eval finished. Results: conversational-summary delta -5.9% (candidate vs baseline). Overall fluency -1.2%. Failure is reproducible.

jen: That's enough to block. Request: pin to v2.4.2, open rollback PR, set final rollout on hold, and add a 'blocked-by-quality' note to the release draft.

kevin: Creating pin PR and updating release draft now. @deploy-bot please hold rollout and set canary traffic to 0 for candidate.

deploy-bot: Actioned: rollout hold enforced. Canary traffic set to 0. Pin PR created: <https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/1284>. Rollback job queued.

zack: Thanks. I'll open a follow-up incident for triage and assign to infra/serving and qa. Suggest 24h investigation SLA and re-evaluate in next change window.

product-ops: PM reviewed and approves holding. Please include a short note in the release changelog: "Tokenizer change caused regression in conversational summarization; rollback applied."

maria.w: :thumbsup: Postmortem plan: reproduce locally, bisect tokenizer commit, test quantized inference path.

kevin: Sounds good. I'll also kick off the broader prompt regression harness overnight and post results here first thing. Will update thread when we have root cause.
